title: [Master]-WIP transfer warehouse shipment incorrectly requires Bin Code
summary: Posting a warehouse shipment for a WIP transfer in Subcontracting no longer incorrectly requires a Bin Code. The fix touches the Subcontracting shipment extension and the base Whse.-Post Shipment codeunit, and adds tests.
key_points: Fixes an incorrect Bin Code requirement when posting WIP transfer warehouse shipments
Changes the Subc. WhsePostShipment Ext codeunit in Subcontracting
Adjusts codeunit 5763 Whse.-Post Shipment in the Base Application
Adds tests for WIP transfer posting
